chapters.intro_ar_source:
سمّى اللّه ذلك اليوم الذي يفنى فيه هذا العالم بأسماء كثيرة، ومن أشهرها:
يوم القيامة، ورد هذا الاسم في سبعين آية من القرآن، كقوله تعالى:
﴿اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾ [سورة النساء: ٨٧].
اليوم الآخر: قال تعالى:
﴿إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾ [التوبة: ١٨].
يوم البعث: قال تعالى:
﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ فَهَذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ﴾ [سورة الروم: ٥٦].
يوم الدين: قال تعالى:
﴿وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ ۝ يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ﴾ [الانفطار: ١٤-١٥].
يوم الخروج: قال تعالى:
﴿يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ﴾ [سورة ق: ٤٢].
يوم الوعيد: قال تعالى:
﴿وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ﴾ [سورة ق: ٢٠].
يوم الخلود: قال اللّٰه عز وجل:
﴿ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ﴾ [سورة ق: ٣٤].
يوم الفصل: قال تعالى:
﴿هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾ [الصافات: ٢١].
يوم الحسرة: قال تعالى:
﴿وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ [سورة مريم: ٣٩].
يوم الحساب: قال تعالى:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ﴾ [سورة ص: ٢٦].
يوم الآزفة: قال تعالى:
﴿وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ﴾ [غافر: ١٨].
يوم الجمع: قال تعالى:
﴿وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾ [سورة الشورى: ٧].
يوم التلاق: قال تعالى:
﴿رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ﴾ [سورة غافر: ١٥].
يوم التناد: قال تعالى:
﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ﴾ [سورة غافر: ٣٢].
يوم التغابن: قال تعالى:
﴿يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ﴾ [التغابن: ٩].
الساعة: قال تعالى:
﴿إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا﴾ [طه: ١٥].
الغاشية: قال تعالى:
﴿هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ﴾ [الغاشية: ١].
القارعة: قال تعالى:
﴿الْقَارِعَةُ ۝ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ ۝ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ﴾ [سورة القارعة: ١-٣].
الواقعة: قال تعالى:
﴿إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ﴾ [سورة الواقعة: ١].
الحاقة: قال تعالى:
﴿الْحَاقَّةُ ۝ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ ۝ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ﴾ [الحاقة: ١-٣].
قال القرطبي في التذكرة: “وكل ما عظم شأنه تعددت صفاته، وكثرت أسماؤه، وهذا مهيع كلام العرب، ألا ترى أن السيف لما عظم عندهم موضعه، وتأكد نفعه لديهم وموقعه، جمعوا له خمسمائة اسم، وله نظائر. فالقيامة لما عظم أمرها، وكثرت أهوالها، سماها اللّٰه تعالى في كتابه بأسماء عديدة، ووصفها بأوصاف كثيرة”.
والمهيع: من الطرق: البيّن، وجمعه: مهايع.

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah has given the Day on which this world will perish many names. Among the most famous of them are:
The Day of Resurrection: This name occurs in seventy verses of the Qurʾān, such as the statement of Allah, the Exalted:
“Allah—there is no deity except Him. He will surely gather you together on the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt.”
 [al-Nisāʾ 4:87]
The Last Day: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The mosques of Allah are only maintained by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day.”
 [al-Tawbah 9:18]
The Day of Resurrection from the Graves: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Those who were given knowledge and faith will say: ‘You remained, according to the decree of Allah, until the Day of Resurrection. So this is the Day of Resurrection.’”
 [al-Rūm 30:56]
The Day of Recompense: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“And indeed, the wicked will be in Hell, entering it on the Day of Recompense.”
 [al-Infiṭār 82:14-15]
The Day of Emergence: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Day they hear the Blast in truth—that will be the Day of Emergence.”
 [Qāf 50:42]
The Day of the Threat: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“And the Trumpet will be blown. That is the Day of the Threat.”
 [Qāf 50:20]
The Day of Eternity: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
“Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”
 [Qāf 50:34]
The Day of Judgment and Separation: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“This is the Day of Judgment which you used to deny.”
 [al-Ṣāffāt 37:21]
The Day of Regret: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will have been decided, while they are heedless and do not believe.”
 [Maryam 19:39]
The Day of Reckoning: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Indeed, those who stray from the path of Allah will have a severe punishment because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.”
 [Ṣād 38:26]
The Approaching Day: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Warn them of the Approaching Day, when hearts will be at the throats, choked with anguish.”
 [Ghāfir 40:18]
The Day of Gathering: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qurʾān so that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it, and warn of the Day of Gathering, about which there is no doubt.”
 [al-Shūrā 42:7]
The Day of Meeting: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Exalted in rank, Owner of the Throne, He sends the revelation by His command to whomever He wills among His servants, so that he may warn of the Day of Meeting.”
 [Ghāfir 40:15]
The Day of Calling Out: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“O my people, I fear for you the Day of Calling Out.”
 [Ghāfir 40:32]
The Day of Mutual Loss and Gain: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Day He gathers you for the Day of Gathering—that is the Day of Mutual Loss and Gain.”
 [al-Taghābun 64:9]
The Hour: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Indeed, the Hour is coming. I almost conceal it.”
 [Ṭā Hā 20:15]
The Overwhelming Event: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Has there reached you the account of the Overwhelming Event?”
 [al-Ghāshiyah 88:1]
The Striking Calamity: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Striking Calamity! What is the Striking Calamity? And what can make you know what the Striking Calamity is?”
 [al-Qāriʿah 101:1-3]
The Inevitable Event: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“When the Inevitable Event occurs.”
 [al-Wāqiʿah 56:1]
The Inevitable Reality: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Inevitable Reality! What is the Inevitable Reality? And what can make you know what the Inevitable Reality is?”
 [al-Ḥāqqah 69:1-3]
Al-Qurṭubī said in al-Tadhkirah:
“Everything of tremendous importance acquires numerous descriptions and many names. This is the well-trodden way of Arabic speech. Do you not see that because the sword held such an important place among the Arabs, and because of its great usefulness and significance to them, they gave it five hundred names? There are many similar examples.
Likewise, because the Resurrection is an immense event and its terrors are many, Allah, the Exalted, has given it numerous names in His Book and described it with many attributes.”
The word “mahyaʿ” means a clear road; its plural is “mahāyiʿ.”

“Indeed, the Hour is coming. I almost conceal it.”
 [Ṭā Hā 20:15]
The Overwhelming Event: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Has there reached you the account of the Overwhelming Event?”
 [al-Ghāshiyah 88:1]
The Striking Calamity: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Striking Calamity! What is the Striking Calamity? And what can make you know what the Striking Calamity is?”
 [al-Qāriʿah 101:1-3]
The Inevitable Event: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“When the Inevitable Event occurs.”
 [al-Wāqiʿah 56:1]
The Inevitable Reality: Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The Inevitable Reality! What is the Inevitable Reality? And what can make you know what the Inevitable Reality is?”
 [al-Ḥāqqah 69:1-3]
Al-Qurṭubī said in al-Tadhkirah:
“Everything of tremendous importance acquires numerous descriptions and many names. This is the well-trodden way of Arabic speech. Do you not see that because the sword held such an important place among the Arabs, and because of its great usefulness and significance to them, they gave it five hundred names? There are many similar examples.
Likewise, because the Resurrection is an immense event and its terrors are many, Allah, the Exalted, has given it numerous names in His Book and described it with many attributes.”
The word “mahyaʿ” means a clear road; its plural is “mahāyiʿ.”

قال تعالى:
﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ ۝ يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَارَىٰ وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ﴾ [سورة الحج: ١-٢].
وقال تعالى:
﴿فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا ۝ السَّمَاءُ مُنْفَطِرٌ بِهِ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا﴾ [سورة المزمل: ١٧-١٨].
وقال تعالى:
﴿يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ ۝ وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ ۝ وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ ۝ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ﴾ [سورة عبس: ٣٤-٣٧].
وقال تعالى:
﴿يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ ۝ وَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ ۝ سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ ۝ لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ﴾ [سورة إبراهيم: ٤٨-٥١].
وقال تعالى:
﴿وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنْسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا ۝ فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا ۝ لَا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا﴾ [سورة طه: ١٠٥-١٠٧].

Allah, the Exalted, says:
“O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the Hour is a tremendous thing. On the Day you see it, every nursing mother will forget the child she was nursing, every pregnant woman will miscarry her pregnancy, and you will see the people appearing intoxicated though they are not intoxicated; rather, the punishment of Allah is severe.”
 [al-Ḥajj 22:1-2]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“How then will you protect yourselves, if you disbelieve, from a Day that will turn children gray-haired? The heaven will split apart because of it. His promise will surely be fulfilled.”
 [al-Muzzammil 73:17-18]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“On that Day a person will flee from his brother, and from his mother and father, and from his wife and children. Every person among them on that Day will have enough concern of his own to occupy him.”
 [ʿAbasa 80:34-37]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“On the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah, the One, the Overpowering. You will see the criminals on that Day bound together in chains. Their garments will be of pitch, and the Fire will cover their faces, so that Allah may repay every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in reckoning.”
 [Ibrāhīm 14:48-51]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“They ask you about the mountains. Say: ‘My Lord will utterly scatter them, leaving the earth a level, barren plain. You will see in it neither depression nor elevation.’”
 [Ṭā Hā 20:105-107]

The word “yuḥbarūn” comes from ḥubūr, meaning intense joy. It is said, “He delighted him,” when he brought him such joy that his face became radiant and the effect of that joy became visible upon him.
Among the blessings of Paradise is that its people will hear beautiful voices that cause their faces to brighten with delight. For this reason, some scholars interpreted ḥubūr as hearing beautiful voices.
Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr said concerning the statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“They will be rejoicing in a garden,”
that it means hearing.
The meaning of this hearing is like what is mentioned in the hadith that the ḥūr al-ʿīn will raise their voices in song. Narrated by al-Tirmidhī (2565).

﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا لَهُمْ فِيهَا أَزْوَاجٌ مُطَهَّرَةٌ وَنُدْخِلُهُمْ ظِلًّا ظَلِيلًا﴾ [سورة النساء: ٥٧].

Allah, the Exalted, says:
“The record will be placed, and you will see the criminals fearful of what is in it. They will say: ‘Woe to us! What is this record that leaves neither a small deed nor a great one except that it has counted it?’ They will find everything they did present before them, and your Lord wrongs no one.”
 [al-Kahf 18:49]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“We have fastened every person’s deeds to his neck, and on the Day of Resurrection We will bring forth for him a record which he will find spread open. ‘Read your record. Today you yourself are sufficient to take account of yourself.’”
 [al-Isrāʾ 17:13-14]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“As for the one who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: ‘Here, read my record! Indeed, I was certain that I would meet my reckoning.’ So he will be in a pleasing life…”
Until His statement:
“But as for the one who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: ‘If only I had not been given my record, and had never known what my reckoning was! If only death had been the end! My wealth has not benefited me. My authority has vanished from me.’”
 [al-Ḥāqqah 69:19-29]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“As for the one who is given his record in his right hand, he will receive an easy reckoning and return joyfully to his people. But as for the one who is given his record from behind his back, he will cry out for destruction and enter a blazing Fire. Indeed, he had lived joyfully among his people. He thought that he would never return. But yes! Indeed, his Lord was always seeing him.”
 [al-Inshiqāq 84:7-15]

Allah, the Exalted, says:
“On the Day you will see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right: ‘Glad tidings for you today—Gardens beneath which rivers flow, remaining therein forever. That is the tremendous success.’
On that Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed: ‘Wait for us so that we may take some of your light.’ It will be said: ‘Go back behind you and seek light.’ Then a wall containing a gate will be placed between them. Inside it will be mercy, while outside it will be punishment.
They will call to them: ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply: ‘Yes, but you put yourselves into temptation, waited, doubted, and false hopes deceived you until the command of Allah came, and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.
So today no ransom will be accepted from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is your proper abode, and what a wretched destination.’”
 [al-Ḥadīd 57:12-15]

“O you who believe, turn to Allah in sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove your sins from you and admit you into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right. They will say: ‘Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. Indeed, You are capable of all things.’”
 [al-Taḥrīm 66:8]
